jsch generate --schema schema.json --overrides overrides.json --out ./model --package model --type Doc

exec go vet ./model
exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string"}
  },
  "required": ["title"]
}
-- overrides.json --
{
  "refs": {
    "#": {
      "goAdditionalFields": [
        {"goIdent": "resolved", "goType": "*Doc"}
      ]
    }
  }
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/overpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
)

// The override file's goAdditionalFields entry should land on the
// root type even though the schema source has no annotations.
func TestDoc_OverrideAddsField(t *testing.T) {
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(Doc{})
	if _, ok := rt.FieldByName("resolved"); !ok {
		t.Errorf("Doc has no resolved field; expected goAdditionalFields override to apply")
	}
}
